defects.detail: The scene includes only Dr. Emily Zhao, but the detection of an anomalous signal from a radio telescope typically involves the telescope itself and possibly other observatory staff or automated systems. The telescope's operational status and data processing are critical to the question, yet no actor representing the telescope or its automated systems is included. This omission could affect the simulation's ability to model the detection process realistically.

The shared context states 'An anomalous signal may be present in the data,' which is knowledge that Dr. Emily Zhao would not necessarily have at the start. This leaks the possibility of the signal into the shared context, potentially influencing her actions. It should be part of her private context or not stated at all.
